result.question: Why were the leaders of Shechem inclined to follow Abimelech?

readings.support: their hearts were inclined to follow Abimelech, for they said, “He is our brother.”

readings.answer: Because his mother’s brothers spoke about him before them.
readings.support: when his mother’s brothers spoke all these words about him in the presence of all the leaders of Shechem | their hearts were inclined to follow Abimelech

assessments.reason: The text explicitly states their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech “for they said, ‘He is our brother,’” which matches this answer.

The clause about his mother’s brothers speaking is introduced by “when” (temporal), while the passage gives the reason with “for they said, ‘He is our brother,’” so attributing the cause to the speech contradicts the stated cause.

result.reason: The passage explicitly states the reason: “for they said, ‘He is our brother.’”
